text: Knapped stone, raw wood and leather wraps. Crude, honest, sharp.
Carved from what the forest left behind. Light, cruel and a little haunted.
The first true metal. Warm bronze, core wood and your first taste of the forge.
Torn from the shell of the Leviathan. Serrated, segmented, salt stained.
Dragged out of sunken crypts. Heavy iron, ancient bark and swamp wood.
Bright silver and wolf fur. Built for the cold and for things that walk at night.
Frozen light set in silver. Spirit damage for the ones that will not stay dead.
Taken from the Fulings, reforged by Vikings. Brutal, dark and battle worn.
Seeker shell and Yggdrasil wood. Alien edges from beneath the mist.
Dwarven craft at its peak. Dark green leather, black iron and caged Eitr that never stops glowing.
Grausten, charred bone and molten Flametal. Weapons that are still cooling when you swing them.
Bloodgold and Timberwood from the frozen north. The last tier of Warfare 2.0.
